variables.cloudInitStart:
#cloud-config
package_update: true
packages:
  - nginx
write_files:
  - path: /opt/novatrix-api/app.py
    permissions: "0644"
    encoding: b64
    content: 
  - path: /opt/novatrix-api/storage.py
    permissions: "0644"
    encoding: b64
    content: 
  - path: /var/www/html/index.html
    permissions: "0644"
    encoding: b64
    content: 
  - path: /etc/nginx/sites-available/default
    permissions: "0644"
    encoding: b64
    content: 
  - path: /etc/systemd/system/novatrix-api.service
    permissions: "0644"
    encoding: b64
    content: 
  - path: /etc/novatrix-api.env
    permissions: "0640"
    content: |
      STORAGE_CONTAINER=arenden
      STORAGE_ACCOUNT=
variables.cloudInitEnd:
runcmd:
  - chown root:www-data /etc/novatrix-api.env
  - systemctl daemon-reload
  - systemctl enable --now novatrix-api
  - systemctl restart nginx
